newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX/COMEX says fire drill halts trade 'till noon.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX/COMEX says fire drill halts trade 'till noon.

text.p: New York Mercantile Exchange said a fire drill halted trading on the trading floors of its NYMEX and COMEX divisions 1130 EDT/1530 GMT until noon.
"It's just a routine fire drill, there are no problems with any of the systems and no problems are expected," an exchange spokesman said.
NYMEX trades crude oil and refined petroleum product futures and options, natural gas and electricity derivatives, and platinum and palladium products.
COMEX lists gold, silver and copper futures and options.
